## Goal
A publication registers its brand (and the few brand-specific components) from its own `papyrus.config.ts`, and the published `@anthusai/papyrus` package contains NO publication code (`publications/threat_intelligence`, `pilobol_us`, `anth_us`). Papyrus's own repo keeps those brands registered through the repo-root `papyrus.config.ts` only (they move to their own repos in Phase 3). Resolves standard-site conflict C1 and spike finding 6 (16 `publications/*` files in the tarball).

## Context (verified)
- `SiteBrandId` and `ThemePackId` are already `string` and `defineSite({ brands, defaultBrand })` exists (`lib/define-site.ts`, `lib/site-brand.ts` L18-20, L99-105). What is left:
  - `lib/site-brand.ts` L3-5 import `publications/{threat_intelligence,pilobol_us,anth_us}/brand`; `BUILT_IN_SITE_BRANDS` L61-97 contains them; `normalizeSiteBrandId` L107-134 has a hand-written alias table (`anthus` -> `threat-intelligence`, `pilobolus` -> `pilobol-us`, `.`/`_` folding); `resolveRuntimeSiteBrandId` L139-143 and `BRAND_OVERRIDE_COOKIE` (also in `lib/site-brand-tenant.ts` L10, `middleware.ts` L5/L9-14/L27-37, `app/layout.tsx` L24-30) implement the demo `?brand=` cookie override, incompatible with one compiled-in brand.
  - Core imports TI-only code: `renderers/pretext/presentation-shell.tsx` L21, L24, L34-35 and `renderers/pretext/article-page.tsx` L10, L18 pick `SITE_BRAND.id === "threat-intelligence" ? <TI component> : <generic>` for `PictogramFigure` / `BlogPageBackground`; `lib/layout-scenarios.ts` L8 and L193-211 import `publications/threat_intelligence/seed/seed-edition-content.json` for the default scenario when the brand is TI.
  - `app/globals.css` L1-4 imports four `publications/*/theme.css` files.
  - `scripts/test-anth-us-brand.cjs`, `scripts/test-theme-packs.cjs`, `scripts/check-bdd-site-brand.mjs`, `features/` use brand ids (`normalizeSiteBrandId("pilobolus")`, `getSiteBrand("pilobol-us")`).
- `packages/papyrus/scripts/stage.mjs` copies `app components lib renderers amplify middleware.ts` and then follows relative imports transitively, which is why `publications/*` files end up in the tarball. `papyrus.config.ts` currently is `defineSite({})` and is not shipped.
- The live Pilobol.us CMS (Amplify app d11eu9hbs2mipk) still builds from Papyrus `main` with `PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=pilobol-us` until Phase 3, so the three brands MUST remain registered in Papyrus's own repo config. Do not delete `publications/*` from the repo in this ticket.

## Exact changes
1. `lib/site-brand.ts`:
   - Remove the three `publications/*` imports and their entries; rename `BUILT_IN_SITE_BRANDS` to `REFERENCE_SITE_BRANDS` holding only `papyrus`.
   - `normalizeSiteBrandId(value)`: `trim()`, return the value if `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SITE_BRANDS, value)` else `null`. Delete the alias table and the `.`/`_` folding. (Exact ids only: `papyrus`, `threat-intelligence`, `pilobol-us`, `anth-us`.)
   - Delete `resolveRuntimeSiteBrandId`; `getSiteBrand()` defaults to `resolveSiteBrandId()` (env `NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND` ?? `PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND`, then `papyrusSite.defaultBrand`, then `"papyrus"`). If the env value is set but not registered, throw `Unknown brand '<x>'. Registered: <list>` at startup (clean failure instead of silently using the default).
   - Add to `SiteBrand`: `components?: { PictogramFigure?: ComponentType<PictogramFigureProps>; BlogPageBackground?: ComponentType<BlogPageBackgroundProps> }` and `demoEdition?: { title: string; editionDate: string; description: string; articles: Article[]; suppressNewsDeskAppendix?: boolean; editionVideo?: ArticleVideoAsset }`. Export the two prop types from the generic components (`components/pictogram-figure.tsx`, `components/blog-page-background.tsx`).
2. Remove the cookie override: delete `BRAND_OVERRIDE_COOKIE` and the `brand` query handling in `middleware.ts` (keep the rest of the middleware untouched; `usesNewsroomRootPaths` reads `resolveSiteBrandId()`), `app/layout.tsx` (`resolveLayoutSiteBrand` -> `getSiteBrand()`, drop `cookies` import), `lib/site-brand-tenant.ts` (`resolveActiveSiteBrand(brandId?)`, drop cookie params), `components/news-desk-page.tsx` L52-53 (drop `cookies`). Grep `BRAND_OVERRIDE_COOKIE` and `brand=` to zero hits in `lib components app renderers middleware.ts scripts features`.
3. Replace TI coupling by slots: in `presentation-shell.tsx` and `article-page.tsx` use `const PictogramFigure = SITE_BRAND.components?.PictogramFigure ?? GenericPictogramFigure;` and `const BlogPageBackground = SITE_BRAND.components?.BlogPageBackground ?? GenericBlogPageBackground;`; delete the TI imports. `lib/layout-scenarios.ts`: `getDefaultScenarioSeed()` returns `SITE_BRAND.demoEdition` mapped to the same shape when present, else the Papyrus fixture; delete the TI JSON import. `publications/threat_intelligence/brand.ts` sets `components: { PictogramFigure, BlogPageBackground }` (imports from its own `pictograms/figure` and `blog-defense/page-background`) and `demoEdition` (imports its own seed JSON). `"use client"` modules imported from `brand.ts` are fine (the brand is read from both server and client modules); confirm `next build` shows no "client module in server file" error.
4. `papyrus.config.ts` (repo root, NOT shipped): `defineSite({ brands: [threatIntelligenceBrand, pilobolUsBrand, anthUsBrand], defaultBrand: "papyrus" })`, importing the three `publications/*/brand` files.
5. Theme CSS without publication imports. `app/globals.css`: remove L1-4 except the Papyrus pack; add `import "papyrus-site-theme";` to `app/layout.tsx` next to `./globals.css`. `withPapyrus()` (`packages/papyrus/src/with-papyrus.mjs`) adds the alias `papyrus-site-theme` -> `<root>/publication/theme.css` if that file exists, else to a shipped empty `lib/empty-theme.css` (new). Papyrus's own `next.config.ts`/`tsconfig.json` paths alias `papyrus-site-theme` -> new `app/dev-themes.css` which `@import`s the four `publications/*/theme.css`. Verify in a scratch consumer (tarball + `withPapyrus`) that the alias resolves under BOTH webpack (`next build`) and turbopack (`next dev --turbopack`); if CSS alias resolution fails under one, fall back to a site-owned `app/layout.tsx` documented in `docs/standard-site.md` section 1.4 (decide and record in this ticket).
6. `packages/papyrus/scripts/stage.mjs`: after staging, fail (throw) if any file under `publications/` was pulled in (`external` set). Add `scripts/test-package-contents.mjs` that runs stage and asserts `publications/` entries == 0 and `lib/empty-theme.css` exists.
7. Update tests: `scripts/test-anth-us-brand.cjs`, `scripts/test-theme-packs.cjs` (coordinate with `PPY-302a5f`: those files are being repaired there; rebase on it or do this after it): replace alias assertions with exact-id assertions; add assertions that `normalizeSiteBrandId("pilobolus") === null` and `normalizeSiteBrandId("anthus") === null`; add a unit test (`scripts/test-site-brand-registry.ts`, `tsx`) that `defineSite({brands:[x], defaultBrand:"x"})` is honored and an unknown `PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND` throws.
8. Docs: `docs/pluggable-publishers.md` section on `SITE_BRANDS` ("add a brand by editing the map") -> the `papyrus.config.ts` flow (conflict C3).

## Data shapes
```ts
// papyrus.config.ts in a publication repo
import { defineSite } from "@anthusai/papyrus/define-site";
import { brand } from "./publication/brand";
export default defineSite({ brands: [brand], defaultBrand: brand.id, backend: { brandId: brand.id } });
```

## Tests
- `npx tsx scripts/test-site-brand-registry.ts`, `node scripts/test-package-contents.mjs`.
- Existing `.cjs` suites updated as in item 7. `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. `npm run build` succeeds with `PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=threat-intelligence`, `pilobol-us`, `anth-us`, `papyrus` (four builds; use `NEXT_DIST_DIR` to keep them apart).
- Gherkin: no new feature (no new user-visible behavior); keep `features/newsroom-app-chrome.feature` passing against `npm run dev` for brand `papyrus` and `pilobol-us`.

## Acceptance checks
- `node packages/stage.mjs --version 0.0.0-brd.1` prints `externalFilesPulledIn: []` (no `publications/`), and `tar -tzf dist-packages/anthusai-papyrus-0.0.0-brd.1.tgz | grep -c publications` prints `0`.
- `grep -rn "threat-intelligence\"\|pilobol-us\"\|anth-us\"" lib components app renderers middleware.ts` has no brand-id comparisons left (ids may appear only in `papyrus.config.ts`, `publications/*`, tests).
- Scratch consumer (tarball + `withPapyrus` + its own `papyrus.config.ts` registering a brand `scratch`, `PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=scratch`) builds and `curl -s localhost:3001 | grep 'data-site-brand="scratch"'` matches.
- `PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND=pilobol-us npm run build` still passes (the live Pilobol CMS builds from Papyrus main).

## Dependencies
Soft: `PPY-302a5f` (shared test files). Blocks `PPY-3e5e9d` (middleware/layout edits), `PPY-961956` (`brand.video` slot) and `PPY-39f928` verification. Conflicts with `PPY-3e5e9d` and `PPY-8ef4ca` on `middleware.ts`/`app/layout.tsx`/`lib/newsroom-nav.ts`: land this first.

## Risks
- CSS alias resolution differs between webpack and turbopack (item 5): decide in a scratch consumer before editing the repo.
- Removing `?brand=` breaks any demo link or BDD step using it: grep `features/step_definitions/layout.steps.js`, `scripts/check-bdd-site-brand.mjs`.
- Phase 3 (TI de-fork) will move TI's brand out; this ticket only makes the seam. Do not move component code.

## Needs Ryan
Nothing.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 2 ticket)
- Work from a clean worktree of `origin/develop` (`git -C /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus fetch origin && git worktree add ../Papyrus-worktrees/<this-ticket> -b feature/PPY-672ea6-<slug> origin/develop`). Never commit to `develop` or `main`; open a PR into `develop`; never merge to `main`. Conventional-commit messages. Update this ticket with branch, PR link and the verification output.
- `AGENTS.md` rules that bind this work: no backward-compatibility shims or fallbacks (clean breaks); backend tooling in Python unless noted; Pretext owns text measurement (do not measure DOM in React); read `AGENTS.local.md` before ANY AWS/Amplify/sandbox command; never run `ampx pipeline-deploy` locally (sandbox only).
- Note on language direction: Ryan's 2026-10-05 correction (epic comment 4174c5) says Papyrus is being ported from Python to TypeScript. Phase 2 follows the approved design in docs/standard-site.md (Python CLI/Lambdas + `papyrus-newsroom`). Keep new Python logic in small pure functions with fixture-driven tests so it can be ported; do not add new Python dependencies beyond those named here.
- Tests: Python unit tests are `unittest` under `procedures/newsroom/tests/` (run: `poetry run python -m unittest procedures.newsroom.tests.<module> -v`); backend Gherkin is `behave` under `features_backend/` with steps in `features_backend/steps/` (run: `poetry run behave features_backend/<file>.feature`); UI Gherkin is cucumber-js + Playwright under `features/` (run against a dev server: `npm run dev` then `PAPYRUS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npx cucumber-js features/<file>.feature`); TypeScript unit tests are `scripts/test-*.ts` run with `npx tsx` (add an npm script `test:<name>` in package.json).
- Install: `poetry install --extras "newsroom markus"` and `npm ci`. Verify `markus --version` prints 0.5.1 (PyPI `anthus-markus` 0.5.1 emits IR `schema_version: 1`).
